facts.text: Serve the snacks when Beldar and Prymaat sit down to their first big feed on Earth.
facts.why: No source opened shows a first big meal. The one eating scene on the Wikiquote page is Prymaat inviting the neighbours to 'the consumption of mass quantities' at a weekend barbecue. TV Tropes only has Beldar eating soap and toilet paper in a motel room.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Prymaat invites the neighbours to consume mass quantities.

vibe.verdict: The Remulak talk is right and the family fits a suburban kitchen, but the snacks are plain and the best moments are missing.
missing: Prymaat inviting Larry and Lisa to 'char some mammal flesh' at the barbecue
Beldar hitting a rock into the Garthok's mouth with his golf swing (Remulak)
'Maintain low tones with me' (Beldar to Connie)
INS agent Gorman posing as a Jehovah's Witness at the door
Beldar saying he is an illegal alien to Otto
ideas: Swap 'Suburban cookout sausages and chicken' note for 'Char some mammal flesh' as Prymaat's barbecue invite.
Swap 'Beldar's lager shandy jug' note for 'Maintain low tones with me.'
Swap 'Cone-shaped ice cream' note for the Garthok golf rock.
Swap the 'Read me first' note for Beldar's real line, 'Maintain low tones, maintain low tones.'
